lines: You're stuck because you're scared to look *stupid.*
#Scared to post your first video and get no *views.*
Scared to walk into the gym and not know what you're *doing.*
Scared to ask the question everyone else *pretends* to know.
And you stay exactly where you *are.*
#Here's the truth. Everyone who's good at something was once *terrible* at it.
But your image isn't paying your *bills.*
#The price of getting good is looking bad for a *while.*
Be the beginner. Ask the *dumb* question.
Six months from now, nobody will remember how you *started.*
They'll only see how far you *came.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
